definitions.explanation: The youngest daughter in a family. Often carries connotations of being spoiled or pampered, as the baby of the family.

examples.japanese: {末娘|すえむすめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦{姉妹|しまい}→姉妹：03201_shimai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{末娘|すえむすめ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: She grew up as the youngest of three sisters.

examples.japanese: {末娘|すえむすめ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{可愛|かわい}がられて⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: The youngest daughter was raised being doted on by the whole family.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧ (end, last) + ⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧ (daughter).

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- {末息子|すえむすこ}: youngest son
- ⟦{末|すえ}っ{子|こ}→末っ子：15132_suekko⟧: youngest child (regardless of gender)
- ⟦{長女|ちょうじょ}→長女：14518_choujo⟧: eldest daughter
- ⟦{次女|じじょ}→次女：15831_jijo⟧: second daughter
- ⟦{三女|さんじょ}→三女：10690_sanjo⟧: third daughter

CULTURAL NOTE:
The youngest child in a Japanese family is often seen as being spoiled or pampered (⟦{甘|あま}やかされる→甘やかす：06625_amayakasu⟧). ⟦{末|すえ}っ{子|こ}→末っ子：15132_suekko⟧ carries this nuance more strongly than {末娘|すえむすめ}.

USAGE:
{末娘|すえむすめ} specifically means the youngest daughter, not just any young daughter. A family could have a {末息子|すえむすこ} who is younger than the {末娘|すえむすめ}.
